title: Wire Smooth / Optimize path operations into Modify > Shape menu
description: smoothPath and simplifyPath (optimizePath) exist in packages/core/src/engine/simplify.ts but are not exposed in the UI. Add a 'Modify > Shape' submenu to MenuBar.tsx with: 'Smooth' (applies Chaikin/corner-rounding to selected shape paths) and 'Optimize...' (opens a dialog with a slider for simplification tolerance). Wire them through Shell.tsx → core functions → pushDoc. Also consider 'Straighten' if a straighten function exists.
